title: 焊缝间隙报警与启动抑制

requirement.en: Control a weld-gap alarm: power-up 5-second initialization inhibition (Operator_Alert FALSE, Weld_Soft_Start_Active TRUE, no debounce accumulation); after init, alarm only after Gap_Exceeded stays TRUE for DebounceTime; signal FALSE switches off the alarm and clears debounce; e-stop priority immediately clears Operator_Alert and debounce.
requirement.zh: 控制焊缝间隙报警：上电后有 5 秒初始化抑制期（Operator_Alert 为 FALSE、Weld_Soft_Start_Active 为 TRUE、间隙去抖不累计）；初始化后仅当 Gap_Exceeded 持续 DebounceTime 后才报警，信号变 FALSE 立即关断报警并清除去抖；急停优先，立即关断 Operator_Alert 并清除去抖计时。

inputs.name: Weld_E_Stop_NC
inputs.desc: 常闭急停，TRUE 表示未触发

ltl_specs.description: 急停优先：急停时不允许报警。
报警意味着间隙当前超限。
初始化抑制期最终会结束。

test_cases.description: 初始化抑制期后去抖报警并复位
急停优先于初始化和正常监控
